title: Indirectly
summary: INDIRECT'LY, adverb Not in a straight line or course; obliquely. 1. Not by direct means. 2. Not in express terms. He indirectly mentioned the subject. 3. Unfairly. Your crown and kingdom indirectly he

inlines.v: INDIRECT'LY, adverb Not in a straight line or course; obliquely. 1. Not by direct means. 2. Not in express terms. He indirectly mentioned the subject. 3. Unfairly. Your crown and kingdom indirectly held.
